description: Pressing Y (pad) on a selected Battlewagon opens the datasheet showing ONLY the weapons it is equipped with. Its roster wargear is Kannon / Lobba / Deff rolla / Grabbin' klaw / Wreckin' ball, so the datasheet must list those (plus the base-kit Tracks and wheels) and must NOT list the killkannon, zzap gun or big shoota the datasheet menu also contains.

steps.comment: WP-O6: the Orks' Weirdboy is offered the codex Da Jump in the movement_phase_start window when the Movement phase starts (it holds the phase like the unit_selected_to_move window below) — not under test, declined

11e 09.02 'Select Unit: ... That unit is selected to move.' + 15.01 'WHEN: When it can be used.': selecting the War Horde Battlewagon opens the Codex: Orks (11e) unit_selected_to_move window (FUNGUS-FUEL INJECTION: 'when a friendly ORKS MOUNTED/VEHICLE unit is selected to move'); the modal dialog swallows Y until it closes
decline the stratagem offer - not under test

steps.script:
var d=tree.root.get_node_or_null("Main/DatasheetModal")
return d.weapons_text.contains("Kannon") and d.weapons_text.contains("Lobba") and d.weapons_text.contains("Deff rolla") and d.weapons_text.contains("Grabbin") and d.weapons_text.contains("Wreckin")

var t=tree.root.get_node_or_null("Main/TokenHoverTooltip")
return t == null or not t.visible
